200.description:
Coverage check of the whole archive: read the archive map (wraws/usaarch.map) and every regional list page it links (43 pages, six at a time) and report whether the per-state page sets `source_status` and `stations` read still reach every station. `drift` names the stations a state's set misses (they sit only on other pages), stations that resolve to no state, and table pages gone from the map, with recomputed page sets to use instead.

The response contains the tool result directly.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `map_last_modified` | string |  |
| `map_url` | string |  |
| `observed_at_ms` | number |  |
| `pages_read` | number |  |
| `publication_id` | string | `archive@sha256:<digest>` of every page's Last-Modified. |
| `retrieved_at` | string |  |
| `source_url` | string |  |
| `states` | object[] | Per state in the table: stations found and the pages its listing reads. |
| `stations` | number | Unique stations across the pages read. |
| `status` | string | `current` when no station escapes its state's page set, every station resolves to a state and every table page is on the map. |
| `suggested_pages` | object[] | For each drifting state, the fewest pages that carry all its stations. |
| `table_pages_missing` | string[] | Pages the table reads that the map no longer links. |
| `unassigned` | object[] | Stations with no state in their label, no known coordinates entry and a shared key prefix. |
| `unassigned_count` | number |  |
| `uncovered` | object[] | Stations whose state's page set does not include any page they appear on. |
| `uncovered_count` | number |  |


These are the provider's documented fields. Field requiredness, nullability and nested object structures are specified only where the descriptions explicitly say so.

post.description: Daily humidity, wind, gusts, solar, fuel temperature and RAWS precipitation for a station and month (daily temperature alone is also in rcc-acis-org as GHCN `USR0000<STN>`).

cursor.description: A `cursor` from a previous `daily` response: re-reads that station-month and fails with invalid_input/publication_changed if the rows no longer hash the same.

month.description: Calendar month `YYYY-MM`, 2000-01 to the current month. Pattern: ^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}$.

station.description: Four-character RAWS station code, e.g. `MNIN`. Pattern: ^[A-Za-z0-9]{4}$.

units.description:
`M` metric (default: °C, m/s, mm, mb, kWh/m²) or `E` English.

Provider reference: allowed values ["M", "E"]; default "M".

200.description:
records/list of daily summary rows, one station x month per call (the segment key): GET wea_monsum2.pl and parse its three header lines (the column set varies with the station's sensors: solar, wind average / vector direction / max gust, air and fuel temperature mean/max/min, humidity mean/max/min, dew point, wet bulb, barometric pressure, total precipitation) and one row per day; the Total/Ave./Max./Min. footer is dropped. Blank cells and -9999 sentinels are null. `source_record_id` is `<stn>:<yyyy-mm-dd>`; `publication_id` is the SHA-256 of the parsed rows. A month the archive has no data for returns zero records with the station's inventory of years; an unknown station is not_found. Metric (`M`) by default, English (`E`) on request; months from 2000-01 to the current month.

The response contains the tool result directly.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `available_years` | number[] | Only for an empty month: the years the station's inventory marks as having data. |
| `columns` | object[] | The station's measured columns for this month (varies by sensor set). |
| `count` | number |  |
| `cursor` | string | Resume token pinned to this station, month and publication; calling `daily` with it re-reads the segment and fails with `publication_changed` if the rows changed. |
| `month` | string |  |
| `next_month` | string | From the page's own navigation links, `YYYY-MM`; the site always links the following month, data or not. |
| `observed_at_ms` | number |  |
| `previous_month` | string | From the page's own navigation links, `YYYY-MM`. |
| `publication_id` | string | `<stn>:<yyyy-mm>:sha256:<hash of the parsed rows>`, or `<stn>:<yyyy-mm>:empty` for a month the archive has no data for. |
| `records` | object[] | One record per day the page lists, in day order. |
| `retrieved_at` | string |  |
| `source_url` | string |  |
| `station_code` | string |  |
| `station_name` | string |  |
| `units` | string |  |


These are the provider's documented fields. Field requiredness, nullability and nested object structures are specified only where the descriptions explicitly say so.

200.description:
Cheap version check of one state's station catalog: GET the regional list pages that carry its stations (Montana: nidwmtlst.html, emtlst.html; at most three pages for any state) and report their Last-Modified, ETag, size, SHA-256 and the unique station count for the state. The CGI data pages carry no validators; their records are hashed per call instead.

The response contains the tool result directly.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `files` | object[] | The regional list pages read for the state, in fetch order (one to three). |
| `notes` | string |  |
| `observed_at_ms` | number |  |
| `publication_id` | string | `<page>@<Last-Modified>` for each list page read, joined by `\|` (Montana: `nidwmtlst.html@...\|emtlst.html@...`): the only validators the site offers. |
| `published_at` | string | Newest Last-Modified of the two list pages, RFC 3339; null if the server stops sending the header. |
| `record_count` | number | Unique stations of the state across the pages read. |
| `retrieved_at` | string |  |
| `source_url` | string |  |
| `state` | string | Postal code of the state listed. |


These are the provider's documented fields. Field requiredness, nullability and nested object structures are specified only where the descriptions explicitly say so.

pages.description:
